messages:
Harini: opened a PR to reconcile a few confusing terms across JS/Python/CLI examples. main tensions: 'model family' vs 'model series', and 'version' vs 'revision' in migration notes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1102
Dmitri: quick thought 1 prefer 'model family' in prose, 'model-family' or 'model_family' as canonical identifiers in code/CLI depending on language. 'series' reads a bit marketing-y.
Lydia: +1 on keeping 'family'. question: 'version' is used everywhere in API responses though. can we map 'revision' -> 'version' in API examples to avoid confusion?
Harini: propose rule: public-facing guides use 'model family' + 'model revision' (to emphasize deployable snapshot), but when quoting API fields keep 'version' as-is and add a side-note. example in PR shows both.
Dmitri: that sounds fair. add a tiny glossary entry: "model revision (user docs) -> version (API field)" so search finds both.
style-bot: reminder: glossary.yml requires an anchor for 'model revision' to make crossrefs work. opened issue #1267.
sam-ci: lint checks failed on PR: examples/python/snippets.py line 12 - inconsistent param name `modelName` vs `model_name`. Please normalize per-language casing.
Lydia: I'll fix the Python snippet to `model_name` and JS to `modelName`. also adding a short note in the PR description explaining casing rules per language: JS camelCase, Python snake_case, CLI kebab-case.
Harini: added example mapping block to the PR to show before/after for readers:
```
# old (ambiguous)
client.generate(model="RedwoodOptV3", version="v3")
# new (canonical)
# Python
client.generate(model_family="redwood-opt", model_revision="v3")
# JS
client.generate({ modelFamily: "redwood-opt", modelRevision: "v3" })
# CLI
redwood generate --model-family redwood-opt --model-revision v3
```
Dmitri: love the mapping snippet. tiny nit: use `redwood-opt-v3` for canonical handles in CLI examples to avoid readers thinking revision is separate token. maybe show both variants: handle vs family+revision.
Lydia: good call. updated snippet to include canonical handle example and mapping to family+revision.
Harini: added a follow-up checklist in PR: (1) add glossary anchors (#1267), (2) run site search index after merge, (3) sweep other quickstarts for 'series' -> 'family' (separate PR).
style-bot: note: keep PR small. please open separate PRs for casing sweeps across languages.
Dmitri: LGTM. moving to reviewers. thanks :sparkles:
